title: Meals at Home
text:
Breakfast is my favourite meal. Every morning I eat bread with butter and drink a cup of milk. Sometimes I eat an egg too.

At lunchtime, my mother makes soup for the family. We eat soup with fresh bread at the kitchen table. After lunch, I like to eat an apple.

questions.text: What does the writer drink every morning?
What does the mother make for the family at lunchtime?
How does the writer probably feel about breakfast?
options: They think it is too expensive

questions.text: What can we infer about the family's meals?
options: They eat in restaurants every day
They eat alone in their rooms
They eat together at the table

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning
a soft yellow food made from cream and spread on bread
a hot liquid food made by cooking vegetables or meat in water

paragraph_translations: Śniadanie to mój ulubiony posiłek. Każdego ranka jem chleb z masłem i piję filiżankę mleka. Czasami jem też jajko.
W porze lunchu moja mama gotuje zupę dla całej rodziny. Jemy zupę ze świeżym chlebem przy stole w kuchni. Po lunchu lubię zjeść jabłko.
